title: My New Apartment
text: Hi! My name is Ben. My family has a new apartment. It has three rooms: a bedroom, a kitchen, and a living room. In the living room, there is a soft sofa and a small table. My bedroom has a big window and a comfortable bed. We do not have a garden, but we have a nice roof with a view. I keep my key in my bag.
